_comment: 定制特殊词读音的示例配置，完整流程见 README「定制词定音」章节 / Example config for special-word pronunciations; see the README's custom-words section

custom_words._comment_native: native_words：每个语言自己的词，读音写进该语言词典 / per-language words whose readings land in that language's dictionary
custom_words._comment_shared: shared_words：各语言混排读相似音的词（品牌/人名），读音落英语词典并自动分发部署词表 / words read similarly across languages (brands, names); readings land in the English dictionary and ship as the deployment wordlist
